moves: 1. Sell Thanksgiving early
Reservations open Nov 2 in all 3 markets; countdown Stories Nov 16-25; Google Search adds 'thanksgiving dinner [city]' + 'restaurants open thanksgiving' terms; GBP post per location each week.
2. Close December
'December weeknights going fast' (Nov 1-15) → GMs call back leads in 24h; carousel of set private rooms (15–50); remarketing to October leads.
3. Own game-day Sundays
Bar-area only: HH $8 drinks / $15 apps all day, TVs on, kickoff Story 30 min before. Confirm channels at all 3 stores (all four Sundays on FOX).
4. Launch gift-card season
Gift-card link in bio Nov 20-30; Story link daily Nov 27-30; table tents + check-presenter insert (proposal). PMax gets a Gift Cards asset group Nov 20.
5. Spend where the empty seats are
Conversion budgets (Sukarra DFW, Prime Rib, Couples Night) only on nights served; no weekly-special promos on Thanksgiving Day (holiday pricing).
6. Sell deadlines, not discounts
'Thanksgiving tables filling' (Nov 16+), 'final tables' (Nov 23), 'gift cards that ship this week' (Nov 30). No discounting.
7. Give SA its own calendar
Home game nights, Holiday in the Park (Nov 21+), River Parade (Nov 27), Día de los Muertos (Nov 1-2). Never post Sukarra to SA.
8. Feed Google Business Profile weekly
One GBP post per location per week: Thanksgiving, game-day Sundays, Prime Rib Wednesday, gift cards. Add Thanksgiving hours to GBP once confirmed.
9. Reviews + UGC on repeat
NFC review cards at every table on game days and Thanksgiving week; reshare tagged Stories daily.
10. Build the December list
Capture holiday-party and Thanksgiving guests' emails (OpenTable notes) for the December gift-card + New Year's sends.
